revision: Founder-requested secondary realised-point dominance added before any comparison run; exact matching remains primary
status: Written preregistration for founder review; no comparison run; not public or committed
scope: A prospective comparison design, not implementation or execution permission
reservation: zone-reservation.csv and reservation.json; other 38 previously assessable N4 zones
prior_exposure: All were used by the original Yorkshire warning/repair study; reserved only from this new comparison

adaptive_primary.scale_a_d: IQR/1.349 of finite steps on max(8,d-56)..d-9, inclusive, if >=20 and positive; otherwise sigma0
adaptive_primary.warning_logic: Existing armed/re-arm-below-threshold logic and >=7 calendar-day spacing
adaptive_primary.comparison_label: adaptive, matched-workload threshold variant; native c=4 remains separately labelled

frozen_secondary.warning_logic: Existing armed/re-arm-below-threshold logic and >=7 calendar-day spacing
frozen_secondary.comparison_label: frozen, matched-workload threshold variant; native c=4 remains separately labelled

cusum_primary_comparator.initial_state: C=0 and no last warning at day index 28
cusum_primary_comparator.update: On a finite step: C=max(0,C+z_d-k). On a missing step: hold C and last-warning time; no warning
cusum_primary_comparator.trigger: (C>=h) AND (no previous warning OR issue time minus last issue time >=168 hours)
cusum_primary_comparator.reset: C=0 only immediately after an issued warning; during spacing holdoff continue updates but do not issue/reset
cusum_primary_comparator.interpretation: One-sided tabular CUSUM; k=.5 is a design choice targeting a roughly one-scale-unit input shift, not a fitted optimum or guaranteed real error rate

common_input.reader: Unchanged Yorkshire protocol revision 1: V/finite/nonnegative L/s times3.6, complete half-hour bins, no gap fill, ambiguous autumn hour missing
common_input.features: Same self-aligning day profiles learned from days0..13, same learned two-hour night window, same causal S_d=mean(night[d-1:d+1])-mean(night[d-8:d-1])
common_input.sigma0: IQR/1.349 of finite S_d at indices8..27; use the unchanged assessability requirements and positive sigma0
common_input.common_calendar: One potential issue at the END of the learned two-hour window on each day d>=28; finite S_d required for every method
common_input.time_basis: Original wall-clock grid; issue=day0+d days+night_start_hour+2 hours; real data arrival/receipt times unknown
common_input.scale_source: First 28 days and causal adaptive past only; no step-2 night-use estimates
common_input.gaps: Missing S_d gives no update/warning; native arming and CUSUM state hold; elapsed spacing uses calendar time
common_input.interpretation_limit: Comparison tests the decision filters on one common high-pass signal; it is not a comparison of all possible leak signals or sensor systems

threshold_calibration.c_grid: 2**(j/8) for every integer j in [-48,64], inclusive; includes original c=4
threshold_calibration.h_grid: 2**(j/8) for every integer j in [-64,96], inclusive
threshold_calibration.selection: For a method, zone and target K, choose the largest grid value with EXACTLY K untouched warnings in that calibration window
threshold_calibration.unattainable: Record all grid counts, mark target unavailable; no grid expansion, monotonicity assumption, interpolation, bisection, random thinning or warning deletion
threshold_calibration.matching: PRIMARY exact-match comparison: exact count AND identical zone/calendar exposure, pairwise adaptive-CUSUM and separately frozen-CUSUM; do not require all three to be available. Secondary realised-point dominance is separately specified
threshold_calibration.zero_warning_points: Report; do not call them positive-workload primary matches or known zero real false-alarm rates. Realised zero-warning points with evaluated responses are eligible for the secondary dominance check
threshold_calibration.freeze: Save thresholds, untouched lists, exposure, parameters/code/input hashes before injections; retain settings for every size/start
threshold_calibration.no_pooling: A correct pooled total cannot substitute for equality within each zone. K is a count in the named window, not the same annual rate across windows of different lengths

injections.shape: Separate permanent constant additions to finite original half-hour bins from onset to file end; retain missing bins, complete past and no stacked additions
injections.development_starts: Use exact saved step1-detectability/run/onsets.csv, 200 distinct half-hour starts per zone; day index56 through last bin minus168h
injections.development_reference: Existing step-1 median of daily minimum complete two-hour 00:00-06:00 means on indices28..364; no change
injections.reserved_rng: NumPy default_rng(SeedSequence([20261019, numeric_DMA_ID, 38])); draw 200 indices without replacement, sort them
injections.reserved_start_pool: Original half-hour indices from day182 00:00 inclusive to the last file timestamp minus168h inclusive; do not exclude gaps, existing warnings or inconvenient dates
injections.reserved_reference: Median daily minimum complete two-hour 00:00-06:00 mean on calibration indices28..181 only; not a loss estimate. If not positive/available retain absolute sizes and mark relative results unavailable

response_and_outputs.primary: Earliest warning with onset<=issue<=onset+168h, issue absent from the paired untouched run, and final input bin issue-30min>=onset
response_and_outputs.secondary: Any-warning response and paired untouched seven-day coincidence probability
response_and_outputs.probability_denominator: All 200 sampled starts; include missing-data windows and nonresponses
response_and_outputs.delay: Median and 25th/75th percentiles among primary responders only; nonresponses retain an explicit flag, not a fabricated 168h delay
response_and_outputs.minimum_size: Smallest tested size with >=90% primary response by168h at that and every larger tested size; otherwise not reached; no smoothing/interpolation
response_and_outputs.workload: ALL untouched issued warnings, including repeats, times365/calendar_days; also report count, valid step nights, calendar days and gap/holdoff opportunities
response_and_outputs.confirmation_rate_matching: PRIMARY exact-match comparison: after settings fixed on calibration only, save all confirmation untouched warning lists before injections. Exact REALISED confirmation counts must match for a matched-rate comparison. Compare every prespecified cross-target pair that exactly matches, including all duplicates; label unmatched points without retuning. Available unmatched points remain eligible for the separately declared secondary dominance check
response_and_outputs.plots: Per-zone delay/response-vs-actual-warning-rate curves with leak size, 24/48/72/168h response curves, and seven-day 90%-size-vs-rate; do not show responder median without probability
response_and_outputs.aggregation: Primary report per zone. Secondary arithmetic mean of response probabilities giving each zone and absolute size equal weight, ONLY at a rate/count shared by all included methods/zones; otherwise unavailable, no selective averaging. Do not average undefined minimum sizes
response_and_outputs.uncertainty: Empirical random-date development/confirmation responses on reused, overlapping real backgrounds; no independent-event confidence claim. Report paired per-start outcomes. Five-zone averages are not Rwanda estimates

secondary_realised_point_dominance.priority: Pre-declared secondary comparison beside the unchanged primary exact-match results
secondary_realised_point_dominance.scope: Every zone and every fixed absolute/relative leak size, development and confirmation separately; never pool zones, sizes or evaluation periods
secondary_realised_point_dominance.point: A realised, already evaluated setting's untouched warning rate (warnings*365/calendar_days) and seven-day PRIMARY injected response probability (successes/all sampled starts)
secondary_realised_point_dominance.eligible_settings: All settings already retained/evaluated under this plan, including native reference points and realised zero-warning points; available unmatched-rate points are included. Do not add thresholds or compute missing points just to obtain dominance
secondary_realised_point_dominance.common_basis: Same zone, fixed leak size, evaluation window, sampled onsets, response definition and denominator for both methods
secondary_realised_point_dominance.a_dominates_b: There exists an actual A setting a witnessing against B setting b: w_a<=w_b AND p_a>=p_b AND (w_a<w_b OR p_a>p_b)

labels_relative_to_a.dominates: The A point dominates the B point under the stated inequalities
labels_relative_to_a.dominated: The B point dominates the A point under the reversed inequalities
labels_relative_to_a.neither: Neither direction dominates, including exact equality of both coordinates

secondary_realised_point_dominance.arithmetic: Use unrounded values. With the same exposure and onset denominator, compare integer warning and success counts directly; do not let display rounding change strictness
secondary_realised_point_dominance.report: For every zone/size, publish every realised setting pair's label beside the exact-match results, with phase, zone, size, method IDs, setting IDs, warning counts/exposure, annualised rates, seven-day successes/denominators and response probabilities; retain all actual witness pairs
secondary_realised_point_dominance.crossing_point_sets: Keep conflicting pointwise relationships visible. A favourable witness against one B setting does not establish dominance over B's whole setting set or a method-wide winner
secondary_realised_point_dominance.missing_points: Unavailable, with reason; absence of a point is not neither, zero warnings or zero response
secondary_realised_point_dominance.interpretation: Descriptive empirical comparison of injected response versus real-background warning workload, not a significance test, real false-alarm estimate, real-leak accuracy claim or new pass/fail rule

fully_invented_false_alarm_diagnostic.purpose: Estimate false alarms where no leak truth is known by construction, separately from real-background warnings. Never call these real utility false-alarm rates or use them to select a model/threshold
fully_invented_false_alarm_diagnostic.night_signal: N_d=phi*N_(d-1)+sqrt(1-phi**2)*epsilon_d, epsilon iid Normal(0,1); N starts at0, discard1000 burn-in observations then retain365
fully_invented_false_alarm_diagnostic.rng: NumPy default_rng(SeedSequence([20261019, 771, phi_index, replicate_index])); indices start0
fully_invented_false_alarm_diagnostic.known_truth: No added leak or change in the generating parameters; every warning is a model-specific false alarm
fully_invented_false_alarm_diagnostic.same_step_construction: Construct S_d from N_d using the same two-vs-seven-night formula. Estimate sigma0 on indices8..27; adaptive a_d uses the existing past window. No real network, demand profiles or physical pressure is represented
fully_invented_false_alarm_diagnostic.settings: Every per-zone target-K setting already frozen from the five-zone development calibration, including native c=4 anchors. No settings fitted on the invented control runs
fully_invented_false_alarm_diagnostic.exposure: Warm up first28days, count337days, annualise365/337; report exclusions if sigma0 is nonpositive instead of silently replacing a replicate
fully_invented_false_alarm_diagnostic.outputs: Count mean/quantiles, false alarms per simulated year, Monte Carlo standard error across independently generated years; display separate panels per phi and setting, not substituted for Yorkshire workload
fully_invented_false_alarm_diagnostic.timing: Future only, after code/plan freeze; not run in this writing step
